params.description: ID of the instant payment object you want to return.

items.docs:
Initiates an outgoing instant payment return. If there is an outstanding return request, invoking this endpoint is
also understood as accepting the active return request.

params.name: instant_payment_id
params.description: ID of the instant payment object you want to cancel.

items.docs:
Attempt to cancel an outgoing instant payment that is currently in "created" or "under_review"
status.

info.name: Request return for an instant payment

params.name: instant_payment_id
params.description: ID of the instant payment object you want to request a return for.

items.docs:
Send a return request to the counterparty for a previously posted outgoing instant payment.
Returns the updated instant payment object with a new entry in the return_requests array.

info.name: Reject return request for an instant payment

params.name: instant_payment_id
params.description: ID of the instant payment object whose return request you want to reject.

items.docs:
Reject the active return request associated with an incoming instant payment.
Returns the updated instant payment object with the status of the active return request set to "rejected".
Check if a given routing number is eligible to receive an instant payment.
